pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto Rājagahe aññatarassa kulassa kulūpako hoti niccabhattiko,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.3: yaṃ tasmiṃ kule uppajjati khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā tato āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa paṭiviso ṭhapiyyati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.4: tena kho pana samayena sāyaṃ tasmiṃ kule maṃsaṃ uppannaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.5: tato āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa paṭiviso ṭhapito hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.6: tassa kulassa dārako rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya rodati maṃsaṃ me dethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.7: atha kho so puriso pajāpatiṃ etad avoca: ayyassa paṭivisaṃ dārakassa dehi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.9: atha kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena taṃ kulaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.10: atha kho so puriso yenāyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.11: hiyyo kho bhante sāyaṃ maṃsaṃ uppannaṃ ahosi, tato ayyassa paṭiviso ṭhapito.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.12: ayaṃ bhante dārako rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya rodati maṃsaṃ me dethā 'ti, ayyassa paṭiviso dārakassa dinno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.16: tañ ñeva me āvuso kahāpaṇaṃ dehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.17: atha kho so puriso āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa kahāpaṇaṃ datvā ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti: yath' eva mayaṃ rūpiyaṃ paṭigaṇhāma evam ev' ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā rūpiyaṃ paṭigaṇhantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.18: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa purisassa . . . vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.20: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto rūpiyaṃ paṭiggahessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.21: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.22: saccam kira tvaṃ Upananda rūpiyaṃ paṭiggahesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.25: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa rūpiyaṃ paṭiggahessasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.26: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.27: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.28.1: yo pana bhikkhu jātarūparajataṃ uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.8: kahāpaṇo lohamāsako dārumāsako jatumāsako ye vohāraṃ gacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.14: idaṃ ayyassa hotū 'ti upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyati, nissaggiyaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.17: tena bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.23: sace tattha āgacchati ārāmiko vā upāsako vā, so vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.30: sappiṃ vā telaṃ vā madhuṃ vā phāṇitaṃ vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.31: sace so tena parivattetvā kappiyaṃ āharati, rūpiyapaṭiggāhakaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbeh' eva paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.32: evañ ce taṃ labhetha, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.35: sace so chaḍḍeti, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.36: no ce chaḍḍeti, pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu rūpiyachaḍḍako sammannitabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.37: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dosāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na mohāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhayāgatiṃ gaccheyya, chaḍḍitāchaḍḍitañ ca jāneyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.40: yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.42: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ rūpiyachaḍḍakaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.46: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno rūpiyachaḍḍakassa sammuti so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.51: tena sammatena bhikkhunā animittaṃ katvā pātetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.52: sace nimittaṃ katvā pāteti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.53.1: rūpiye rūpiyasaññī rūpiyaṃ paṭigaṇhāti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.54: rūpiye vematiko rūpiyaṃ paṭigaṇhāti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.55: rūpiye arūpiyasaññī rūpiyaṃ paṭigaṇhāti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.60: ajjhārāme vā ajjhāvasathe vā uggahetvā vā uggahāpetvā vā nikkhipati
